items.title: DJ Moore: Practicing, but not yet taking contact
items.text:
Moore (shoulder) was spotted on the field for the open portion of Wednesday's practice but was donning a no-contact jersey, Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Aaron Jones: Won't practice Wednesday
items.text:
Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Jones (knee) won't practice Wednesday, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

items.title: Ja'Marr Chase: Absent from Wednesday stretch
items.text:
Chase wasn't spotted during the stretch portion of Wednesday's practice, Mike Petraglia of CLNSCincy.com reports.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Progressing in recovery
items.text:
Head coach Todd Bowles said Egbuka (concussion/foot) took part in individual drills Wednesday, but the wide receiver will need to do more Thursday to progress toward a return to action, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
